purpose: Attributed starting points for color, composition, hierarchy, and platform adaptation; not a benchmark dataset.
selection: Six purposively selected official award entries: three websites and three native apps. Not representative or statistically sampled.

evidencePolicy.awards: Status verified against the awarding organization's page; award scores intentionally excluded from design factors.
evidencePolicy.observations: Official descriptions are attributed paraphrases. Four historical official screenshot assets were also inspected by isolated Astra reviewers; pixel observations are individually scoped. Transfer hypotheses are synthetic reviewer judgments, not awarding-body claims or human validation.
evidencePolicy.geometry: No screenshot-derived sizes, spacing, ratios, breakpoints, or cross-device geometry.
evidencePolicy.deviceCoverage: Only the two Apple iPhone presentations are visually observed as historical official screenshots. No live device behavior was tested. Website asset dimensions are not CSS viewports; mobile, iPad, and desktop behavior remain unknown.
evidencePolicy.rights: Metadata-only deliverables. Official images were temporarily downloaded for inspection and deleted; no third-party assets are retained or licensed for reuse.

retrievalNotes: Awwwards detail pages were read from official HTML after the web extractor timed out.
Apple and CSS Design Awards descriptions were read from official award pages.
Four official image assets were visually inspected: Crouton, Bears Gratitude, Seasoned, and Editorial New. No live award website/app session was inspected.
Apple award announcement date is corroborated by https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=6qt455k0
Visual inspections occurred 2026-10-24 America/Detroit (2026-10-25 UTC); source image publication dates are historical and current app/site freshness is unknown.
